scope: Machine-readable required input contracts for existing producers; this catalogue is not an executable campaign or proof of supplied observations/accepted forward models.

asset_binding.meaning: Actual regular file with exact SHA256

required_content: indicator columns consumed by original stellar_observations._ladder_design
anchor host IDs, distance moduli and full covariance
original photometric covariance and instrument zeropoint calibration
fit redshift bounds, cosmographic q0/j0, flow dispersion and declared priors
distance_ladder.estimator_scope: Original GLS or selected-likelihood local curvature; these results are not posterior draws.

required_content: measured delays and original full covariance or measured uncertainties
measured image bands, instrument flux/noise, PSF, angular pixel transforms
original astrometry, kinematics and LOS priors when used
explicit source selection and lens identity namespace
normalized expansion-shape E(z) covering lens/source, curvature assumption
distance sampling and actual MCMC/emcee/zeus sequence
time_delay.posterior_scope: Only full sampled lens-model posterior reaches time_delay_posteriors; reduced Gaussian approximations rejected.

bao.row_policy: Exact original ordered measured rows and full positive-definite measured covariance; no diagonalization/renormalization.
model_inputs: exact original CLASS baryon-drag execution/log/invocation from same model
bao.calibration_scope: Original CLASS predicted sound horizon is a fixed physical-model input; it is not a measured CMB likelihood.
bao.posterior_scope: Existing two-dimensional alpha_perp/alpha_parallel distance dilation sampler; not H0.

required_content: explicit selected measured CMB likelihood or released chain/data manifest
original measured covariance and nuisance/calibration/selection assumptions
sound-horizon and cosmological parameter convention with original provenance
cmb.missing_policy: BAO graph labels CMB likelihood NOT_SUPPLIED; a CLASS background cannot stand in for measured CMB constraints.

required_lineage: accepted physical forward-domain receipt with source-bound simulator signature
frozen actual model and original parameter priors/units before heldout truth access
original posterior draws/weights or real sampler chains
actual heldout SBC integer ranks, randomized PIT, independent component rows, coverage and original tests
training-only OOD reference and original inference thresholds
paired identical heldout graph/baseline calibration with original paired score/bootstrap decisions
figure_source: completed original stream-stage-receipt-v1 with current producer/source hashes
original source-bound numeric product; no caller-created accuracy flag
inference.missing_policy: No accepted forward model, frozen calibration or supported observational input is invented. Unaccepted calibration and OOD rejection remain visible.

branch_preparation.command: python commands.py native-prepare sbi REQUEST DESTINATION
branch_preparation.original_gate: Original accepted-forward-domain-v1 receipt with unchanged current forward_signature, observable_contract, actual parameter_bounds, PASS force/time_integration/progenitor/observation/selection/model_discrepancy controls and current source hashes.
branch_preparation.lineage_policy: Original deterministic union-find split uses actual supplied parent_realization and lineage_ids before training; supplied design count cannot be expanded by relabeling repeated parents. Actual independent test component count must meet original calibration floor.
branch_preparation.predictive_scope: The designated-design posterior predictive uses its own original physical likelihood/sampler conditional on that known design. It is distinct from the SBI posterior marginalized over native training design identities.
branch_preparation.required_runtime: Existing bootstrap.py SBI profile / requirements-sbi installs recorded SBI backend and existing inference sampler dependencies; signature preparation uses PyTorch encoder but never trains a model.
branch_preparation.missing_policy: Missing accepted physical controls, measured observations or adequate independent lineage inventory are exact required inputs; preparation rejects them. No fake acceptance/calibration/source measurements are generated.

figure_preparation.execution: Original cosmography/streams public command followed by source-bound Hubble/inference graph stages; actual product paths and hashes resolve from completed generations.
